dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, your friends are really nice!
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, jʊr ˈfrɛndz ər ˈriːli ˈnaɪs!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Thanks! What did you think of Ploy?
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋks! ˈwʌt dɪd juː ˈθɪŋk əv ˈplɔɪ?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: She's extremely funny, and she's very friendly.
dialogue.reading: ʃiːz ɪkˈstriːmli ˈfʌni, ənd ʃiːz ˈvɛri ˈfrɛndli.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: He's a bit quiet, but he's really kind.
dialogue.reading: hiːz ə ˈbɪt ˈkwaɪət, bʌt hiːz ˈriːli ˈkaɪnd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: He's quite shy. But last month, he sang at karaoke in front of fifty people!
dialogue.reading: hiːz ˈkwaɪt ˈʃaɪ. bʌt ˈlæst ˈmʌnθ, hiː ˈsæŋ ət ˌkɛriˈoʊki ɪn ˈfrʌnt əv ˈfɪfti ˈpiːpəl!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: What about my sister? Did you talk to Fah?
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌt əˈbaʊt maɪ ˈsɪstər? dɪd juː ˈtɔːk tə ˈfɑː?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Yes! She's quite confident, and she's a bit noisy!
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs! ʃiːz ˈkwaɪt ˈkɑːnfɪdənt, ənd ʃiːz ə ˈbɪt ˈnɔɪzi!
